notes.title: YOGA MASTER one of the best fitness game of 2022 for "Screen Rant"
notes.notes:
YOGA MASTER is one best fitness game of 2022 according "Screen Rant" website.

Here the words of the article:
"With more than 150 yoga moves to learn, Yoga Master is a great way to both exercise and relax. Created with the help of real yoga instructors, the game promotes itself as the premier virtual yoga experience. Players can choose yoga poses that are ranked from easy, medium, and pro, and can even pick how long they want their yoga session to be.
From there, the virtual yoga instructor shows players how to make the various poses and walks them through a guided session."
